# 461: #394 Pi 400 U-Boot TCP receive window 32768 (PR #465 6db1f42b, on top of the discard-counter fix)

**Result: fail, 17 of 20.** With the 32 KB window, 17 of 20 serial reboots reached `redox login:` without a manual `boot`. Boots 3, 11 and 16 stopped at the U-Boot prompt after all 3 HTTP and 3 TFTP tries for the image failed. Retries were still common: **19 of 20** boots had at least one failed DHCP try or load. **The discard count of RX ring 16 was 0 in all 40 dumps** (row 460 B: non-zero in 25 of 44). So the smaller window stops the dropped frames, but not the failed loads. Image load time (the successful wget): min 2101 / median 2402 / max 22409 ms, against 815 / 2136 / 15364 ms in row 460 B.

- Image: row 325's (`v0.5.0-dev-90-g92a6387c+x54e8`, `harddrive.img.gz` untouched), Pi 400, netboot from `/srv/tftp/pi400/`, serial ttyUSB1, SD slot as it was. No person, no power cycle. 2026-11-16, 13:39–14:24 UTC.
- Built in my own worktree `~/redox-rpi-pitest-retry`, detached at 6db1f42b (nothing switched in a shared clone; the new script builds from an export in `build/u-boot-src`, and my clone's `upstream/u-boot` stays untouched):
  - `u-boot.bin`: `scripts/build-uboot.sh rpi-net 192.168.178.120 pi400`, with the build lock, after removing the old object dir. sha256 `69acb0e6…`. Check: `grep LWIP_TCP_WND build/u-boot-net-pi400/obj/.config` gives `CONFIG_LWIP_TCP_WND=32768`. The discard fix is in (`DMA_P_INDEX_MASK` at bcmgenet.c lines 141, 342, 414 of the export).
  - `netboot.scr`: `scripts/netboot.sh --server 192.168.178.120 --board pi4`, sha256 `04c8ca96…`. The script text (`netboot.cmd`) is the same as row 460's; only mkimage's header time differs.
- Before: u-boot.bin `0aafc622…`, netboot.scr `a55675cf…` (row 325 state), copies kept.
- A first start at 13:38 did nothing: I had made `run461.sh` without the execute bit (exit 126 before the first line). Files were unchanged; started again at 13:39.

### Image load time against row 460 B

| | min | median | max |
|---|---|---|---|
| row 460 B (window 3000000) | 815 ms | 2136 ms | 15364 ms |
| row 461 (window 32768) | 2101 ms | 2402 ms | 22409 ms |

### RX ring 16

All 40 dumps: discard count 0. The consumer equals the producer in every dump. The producer index again jumps by about 0x7b00–0x7c00 within a few seconds in four boots: 9 (0x0507 → 0x8054), 10 (0x0729 → 0x82f0), 14 (0x03f7 → 0x8004) and 16 (0x0c60 → 0x87bf). None of these boots failed because of it: 9, 10 and 14 came through, and 16 had already failed 8 times at low indices. The failed boots 3 and 11 stayed below 0x0a00. So the 0x8000 lead from row 460 doesn't explain the failures.

The failures look the same as in 454 and 460: each HTTP try `HTTP client error 5`, each TFTP try `Loading: Timeout!`.

### Afterwards

Old `u-boot.bin` and `netboot.scr`/`netboot.cmd` back at 14:23:32, **hashes checked: `0aafc622…` and `a55675cf…`, the same as before.** Serial reboot with the old files: `redox login:` at 14:24:34 at the first try. `/srv/tftp/pi400/harddrive.img.gz` (`59d9e258…`) and `keep/pi400-combo-stage/` (`1534ee85…`) untouched.

Files on homenodellm: `~/pitest-tools/t461/` (events.txt, B-boot-01…20.log, boot-restore.log, fulldumps.txt, perboot.md, u-boot-6db1f42b.bin, the generated netboot.scr, the old files, uboot-build.txt, config-check.txt).
